arguments.message: Lilian here. Given my 4h availability and private costs, ISSUE-0001::triage is my best feasible low-cost fit; I plan to claim it unless coordination indicates otherwise. Please coordinate distinct task choices to avoid duplicates, especially across the ISSUE-0001 tasks.

Issue 1 review looks like a good high-priority fit for you (1.5h). If you want it, plan to claim ISSUE-0001::review; I'll avoid overlap in execution.
To keep choices distinct, I plan to take ISSUE-0001::review (high priority, 1.5h) unless coordination changes; please plan around that for now.

I currently plan ISSUE-0002::test, but note ISSUE-0002::implement (critical, 7h) is the remaining unclaimed task; my own cost is 13.34 versus 9.34 for test, so I favor retaining test unless another agent has a materially better implement fit and wants to swap. Please coordinate before execution; distinct claims already cover the other listed tasks.

Lilian confirms I plan to claim ISSUE-0001::triage (1.2h, feasible; cost 2.87), keeping distinct from the current plans for Issue 1 review/docs/test and Issue 2 review/test. I will hold until execution; ISSUE-0001::implement is also unclaimed but its cost is higher for me.

Lilian confirms I plan to claim ISSUE-0001::triage (1.2h, feasible at 4h availability; cost 2.87). This remains distinct from Vonnie's stated Issue 1 review plan. Holding until execution; please flag if any plan changes.
Judi confirms planned ISSUE-0002::review for execution (critical priority, effort 3.5h within 10h availability, cost 6.02). This remains distinct from current plans; I will hold until execution.

Keep Judi on ISSUE-0002::review, Agripina on ISSUE-0002::test, Vonnie on ISSUE-0001::review, Lissa on ISSUE-0001::test, and Lilian on a feasible Issue 1 task (triage is the currently stated low-cost fit). I’ll retain ISSUE-0001::review as my planned distinct choice. ISSUE-0002::implement is feasible for me, but Latoyia has offered a lower-cost feasible fit, so she should take it; I’ll avoid competing and hold until execution.
